lede: Baltimore Ravens carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#6 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Atlanta Falcons +2.3 with a fair total of 46.1 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Baltimore Ravens run offence vs Atlanta Falcons run defence, which sits +0.137 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
